meta.name: bgpt-paper-search
meta.description: Search scientific papers and retrieve structured experimental data extracted from full-text studies via the BGPT MCP server. Returns 25+ fields per paper including methods, results, sample sizes, quality scores, and conclusions. Use for literature reviews, evidence synthesis, and finding experimental details not available in abstracts alone.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索科学论文并提取结构化实验数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要从全文论文中快速获取实验数据细节。
copy.tagline_en: Search papers and extract structured experimental data.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need detailed experimental data from full-text papers.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会通过 BGPT MCP 服务检索科学论文,返回从全文提取的结构化数据:每篇 25+ 字段,含方法、结果、样本量、质量评分与结论。
howto.when: 做文献综述、证据综合,或需要摘要里没有的实验细节(如定量结果、样本量、方法)时用它;需先在 agent 中配置 BGPT MCP 服务器。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude searches scientific papers through the BGPT MCP server and returns structured data extracted from full texts — 25+ fields per paper including methods, results, sample sizes, quality scores, and conclusions.
howto.when_en: Use for literature reviews, evidence synthesis, or experimental details not in abstracts, e.g. quantitative results, sample sizes, methods. Requires the BGPT MCP server configured in your agent.

Compare sample sizes and effect sizes across these studies
